title: Corpses
description: Corpses is a server side Fabric mod, only for Minecraft 26.2 that adds corpses that spawn when a player dies
body:
# Corpses
Corpses is a server side Fabric mod for Minecraft 26.2 that spawns corpses when a player dies, instead of dropping items everywhere.
## Lag prevention
After 5 seconds of being empty, corpses sink into the ground and are deleted at the next second

![sinking demonstration](https://i.imgur.com/1k9slaz.gif)
